notes.title: Sunrise GP Races Onto Steam: Mark Your Calendar for August 27th, 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/1eeda774a29d6e4e8b39fcf0a0df828bbda40d2f.jpg[/img]
[h2]We’re thrilled to share the official release date of [b]Sunrise GP[/b] on Steam. [/h2]

[i]Get ready for an exhilarating racing adventure with a road trip twist! But that’s not all—here’s what you can expect from this game:
[/i]

🏆 [b]Arcade[/b] Gameplay: Perfect blend of high-speed racing and the relaxed vibes of a road trip.
🎵 [b]Synthwave[/b] Music: Each race is accompanied by unforgettable music that sets the mood.
🚗 [b]European Classic[/b]-Inspired Cars: Take the wheel of classic cars and explore vibrant locations.
🎨 [b]Customization[/b]: Personalize your car with decals, spoilers, exhausts, and more.
🎮 [b]Multiplayer[/b]: Gather your friends for split-screen multiplayer action (up to four players).
🏁 [b]Challenge[/b] Mode: Conquer single-player races in the core Grand Prix experience.
📸[b] Photomode[/b]: Capture stunning moments with your favorite cars against breathtaking backdrops.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/


Mark your calendar for August 27th, and stay with us as we count down the weeks to an epic gaming experience! 🎉🕶️🏁

notes.title: Sunrise GP Demo is now Live!
notes.content:
[h3]🌅 Get Ready for Sunrise GP! 🏎️[/h3]

As we gear up for the full release (date to be announced soon!), we’re thrilled to invite everyone to check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/][b]Sunrise GP[/b][/url] demo! 🎮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/d797d832ba7aed2be4076b3435b2dc1ef58b3ecb.jpg[/img]

[h3]🛣️ What’s in the Demo?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Experience the first four routes (out of 20!) in both [b]Grand Prix[/b] and[b] Quick Race[/b] modes.
[*] Test out the [b]multiplayer mode with up to four players[/b] on a split screen.
[*] Have a blast with the [b]Photo Mod[/b]e!
[/list]
[b]🎶 + Full Soundtrack Included[/b]: The demo features the entire soundtrack from the full version, setting the tone for an adrenaline-fueled racing experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/7f8325cf65ef23e8bb2b67b0ced5d895c09703ac.jpg[/img]

🌞 Stay Tuned! Sunrise GP’s[b] full release on Steam is scheduled for this summer[/b]. Keep an eye out for more updates and exciting news! 🚀

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/

[i]~Garage 5 & Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: Sunrise GP will land in 2024 on Steam!
notes.content:
Introducing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/?beta=0][b]Sunrise GP[/b][/url] - Your Ultimate Roadtrip Adventure on Steam! 

[previewyoutube=XQp6bjcA7lw;full][/previewyoutube]

Are you ready for an [b]exhilarating racing action [/b]combined with a [b]road trip vibe[/b]? We've got just the title for you – Sunrise GP set to make its debut on Steam in 2024!

Following the successful launch on Nintendo Switch in April 2023, where it garnered rave reviews, we've been hard at work to bring excitement to the PC gaming community. Now, you can explore the sunny Grand Prix landscapes right from the comfort of your computer.

[h3]What to expect from Sunrise GP:[/h3]

🏆 Immerse yourself in [b]arcade gameplay [/b]that seamlessly blends [b]high-speed racing with the laid-back vibes [/b]of a road trip.
🏆 Soak in [b]synth-wave music [/b]that enhances the atmosphere of each race, creating a memorable experience.
🏆 Drive [b]cars inspired by European classics [/b]through [b]retro-inspired locations [/b]vibrant in colors.
🏆 [b]Customize your car's appearance [/b]with a plethora of options, including decals, spoilers, exhausts, and more!
🏆 Enjoy [b]multiplayer [/b]fun with split-screen capability, accommodating up to four players for a thrilling gaming session.
🏆 Take on the [b]Challenge Mode[/b], a series of single-player races that make up the titular Grand Prix.
🏆 Capture stunning moments with the [b]in-game Photomode[/b], showcasing your favorite cars in breathtaking localisations.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/?beta=0

And this is just a sneak peek! Stay tuned as we unveil more details about Sunrise GP in upcoming posts.

If you're a fan of arcade racing, a lively atmosphere, and the joy of multiplayer gaming on a split screen, buckle up and join us for the ride!
